response.text:
I can do that — just need two quick confirmations before I create the event:

1) Which Tuesday do you mean (date)? If you mean next Tuesday, that would be Sep 8, 2026.  
2) Does "4" mean 4:00 PM Chicago time (your time) or 4:00 PM Singapore time (her time)?

Also please provide (or confirm): auditor's name and email (or say "use contact on my calendar"), desired event title (default: "Intro with external auditor"), whether to add a video conference (Google Meet/Zoom) and any other attendees or notes to include.

If you want me to proceed with defaults, say "Go ahead with defaults" and list the auditor email (or say use contact).
